create.title: Physical-height finite-section BV lemma
create.statement_tex: Let I_(U,V)(L)=[-V,V] intersect [L-U,L+U] and R(L)=int_(I_(U,V)(L)) K(L,nu)dnu on a signed saddle cell of L-length O(lambda). If |K(L,nu)| is at most M lambda^(-2)w(nu), |partial_L K(L,nu)| is at most M lambda^(-3)w(nu), and the same integrable weight controls the translated endpoint traces, with w in L1, then ||R||_infinity+Var_L R is O(M lambda^(-2)||w||_1), uniformly through all affine U,V faces. Fixed nu faces have zero velocity; moving nu=L plus or minus U faces are controlled by substitution. The lemma estimates translation and endpoint traces together and does not follow from termwise fixed-mu derivative bounds.
create.next_action: Write the complete omega-recombined physical-height kernel and prove the lemma's two weighted symbol hypotheses uniformly through axial, radial-side, and height-exhaustion seams.

create.title: Separated R1 regular finite-part BV and local q-minus-two
create.statement_tex: On either signed post-endpoint R1 saddle with |alpha| asymptotic to lambda, bounded beta, fixed b>0, and positive separation from rho=0, v=0, and finite transition endpoints, remove the explicit Plemelj delta and q^(-4) face-log terms. In physical height coordinates the exact remaining kernel K_R1(L,nu)=-i f_b(L)/[2A(A+i(L-nu)/2)]+[f_b(nu)-f_b(L)]/[(L-nu)(A+i(L-nu)/2)] satisfies |K_R1| at most C_b lambda^(-2)w_b(nu) and |partial_L K_R1| at most C_b lambda^(-3)w_b(nu) for an integrable weight. Hence its finite-section sup plus BV norm is O_b(lambda^(-2)); multiplying by the accepted numerator (D_j/q)lambda gives D_j/(q lambda)=D_j/(q^2 theta_j(x)). This excludes the artificial and axial seams, joint height exhaustion, connectors, radial sides, and complete sums.
create.next_action: Use this only on separated fixed-b R1 patches; prove the common recombined kernel estimate before crossing rho=0 or exhausting heights.

create.title: Complete recombined physical-height symbol bound
create.statement_tex: After forming omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1 with identical beta masks, finite U,V,S domains, endpoint conventions, radial ledgers, and one combined delta/log subtraction, write the regular kernel as K_complete(L,nu). Prove |K_complete(L,nu)| at most X^epsilon lambda^(-2)w_b(nu) and |partial_L K_complete(L,nu)| at most X^epsilon lambda^(-3)w_b(nu), including the exact inherited h,D_j,x monomial, for an integrable weight whose norm is polylogarithmic as b downarrow zero after the v=0 residue is extracted. Prove compatible translated endpoint traces, finite radial-side bounds, and joint U,V,S exhaustion. This implies the complete regular finite-part BV target by the physical-height finite-section lemma.
create.next_action: Derive one exact common K_complete(L,nu) before splitting endpoints; audit its ordinary L derivative, axial residue, radial endpoint Taylor coefficients, and joint height tails.
